sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Release events column: filtering or sorting a table while the column was still loading made it come back EMPTY for the rows that were hidden at that moment — permanently, because the column is filled once per fetch. On a label's or place's relationships page, typing a country code into "Release country" before the data arrived and then clearing the filter left every one of those rows blank for the rest of the visit.

The same filter, retyped after the data arrived, also kept showing the pre-load result (no rows), because the rows it had already tested were remembered by what you had typed, and typing the same thing again reused that answer.
A filter left active while the column loads is now re-applied on its own once the values arrive, instead of leaving the table filtered on data that had not loaded yet.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: ShowAllEntityData_HELP.txt: the Release events section said "one WS2 call per release row"; it is one call for the page's own entity. Corrected, and it now states that filtering and sorting while the column loads is safe.
